classification.difficultyReason: Read each horizontal translation from square form and sketch the unchanged parabola shape with its vertex at the corresponding x-coordinate.

content.prompt: On the same set of axes, sketch the graphs of $y=(x-h)^2$ for $h\in\{-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3\}$.

answer.short: Seven upward-opening parabolas of the same shape, with turning points $(-3,0),(-2,0),(-1,0),(0,0),(1,0),(2,0),(3,0)$.
answer.worked: Translate $y=x^2$ horizontally by $h$ units. Each graph has turning point and sole $x$-intercept $(h,0)$, axis of symmetry $x=h$, and $y$-intercept $(0,h^2)$. The respective $y$-intercepts are $(0,9),(0,4),(0,1),(0,0),(0,1),(0,4),(0,9)$.

spec.description: Seven horizontal translations; vertices identified by labelled x-axis ticks, as in the teacher figure.
